definitions.major: cycle.major — RV32IM instruction-class column (0-12); see GLOSSARY §RISC-V
definitions.minor: cycle.minor — sub-class within major; kind = major*8 + minor
definitions.success_rate: fraction of sampled steps where get_targets_at_step returned a valid target
definitions.decode_match: decoded (major,minor) from raw instruction word equals trace cycle (major,minor)

MEM_VAL_MOD|core_arithmetic.interpretation: Most targets are register-file or user-data mem txns co-located with ALU steps — RAM consistency / permutation proof witnesses, not standalone loads.

MEM_VAL_MOD|core_mul.interpretation: MUL-zone mem txns are sparse co-located memory witnesses during multiply micro-ops; subset of steps with mem activity at user PC.

verdict: Targets are real mem-txn mutation sites (register-file and user-data consistency witnesses), not scratch-buffer phantoms. Keep arms; restrict D42 nondet addresses in Inc 2+.
